hash_specs.phash: 32x32 grayscale DCT-II (ortho); top-left 8x8; median of 63 non-DC coefficients; DC bit fixed to 0
hash_specs.ahash: resize 8x8 grayscale; threshold = mean pixel value
hash_specs.whash: 32x32 grayscale DCT-II; top-left 8x8; threshold = mean coefficient
hash_specs.ensemble: unweighted mean of the four per-hash Hamming distances divided by 64

config.rotation_convention: PIL rotate; positive = counter-clockwise, expand=True, white fill

dataset.note: Pilot convenience sample of web photographs, not a benchmark dataset; no AIGC images.
